home.services: Food • Medicine • Groceries • Urgent items • Errands
home.promise: Urban Night Lift helps you get what you need at night without leaving your home. We handle safe night pickup and delivery of food, medicine, groceries, urgent items, and approved errands within Yaoundé.
home.operatingHours: We operate from 6:00 PM to 4:00 AM.
home.serviceArea: Currently serving selected areas in Yaoundé.
home.safetyPositioning: Verified pickups. Controlled zones. Delivery proof. Prepayment only.
home.launchNote: Launching in selected zones first — not yet available everywhere.
home.heroCtaSub: Food, medicine, groceries & more — to your door, tonight.
home.step1Body: Pick a service and share pickup, drop-off and item details in under a minute.
home.step2Body: A verified rider collects your order from approved pickup points.
home.step3Body: Track your rider and confirm delivery with a one-time code or photo.
